text:
deploy-bot: Preflight dry-run finished for release rc-2026-03-21. Feature flag 'session-cache-v2' dry-run results attached. Priority-signal gating: CPU, mem, p99 latency, error-rate - all within thresholds for 10% and 50% simulated traffic. See logs: https://internal/redwood/dryruns/rc-2026-03-21 :white_check_mark:

emma: Nice, thanks deploy-bot. Did the canary cohort hit any KV miss spikes during the simulated burst?

leo: No big KV misses in canary. Observed a small p99 bump (~1.1%) on the embeddings route during sustained QPS spike, nothing that correlated with errors.

ops-qa: Recommend we hold at 10% for a 5m soak in production before moving to 50%. We saw transient GC tail latency on one host in the dry-run - want to see a clean soak.

sam: +1 to hold. Also suggest pinning the model version for cohort=canary to model@v3.2 to avoid auto-roll during the soak window. If we hit +2.5% p99 or any 5xx spike, we auto-roll back.

marie: Added the rollout snippet to the release notes draft: https://internal/redwood/releases/rc-2026-03-21/notes. Quick snippet for ops if we need to fast-disable the flag:

```bash
# fast-disable session-cache-v2 for all traffic
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://api.redwood.internal/flags/session-cache-v2/disable
```

emma: Good. Who's on pager for the 22:00 change window? I can cover first 20m then hand off to oncall.

ops-qa: I'll be second. @leo you up for monitoring model routing and embeddings telemetry?

leo: Yep, I’ll watch embeddings p99 and kv_miss_rate. I’ll set a Grafana alert at 1.5% p99 delta and an Ops channel hook.

sam: I've added a canary rollback playbook entry and the deploybot will create a rollback ticket if the hook fires. playbook snippet: "If p99 > 2% or 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3m -> disable flag -> pin traffic back to previous routing -> escalate to release lead."

deploy-bot: Note: Dry-run included simulated region failover. Auto-fallback to model@v3.1 verified. No config drift detected.

marie: OK - plan: start ramp 22:00 UTC -> 10% + 5m soak -> check signals -> 50% -> 30m soak -> full open if stable. Everyone OK with that? :thumbsup:

emma: :thumbsup: locking this plan. I'll post a final call 10m before window.

ops-qa: Copy. I’ll also attach the post-soak checklist to the release notes.

leo: I'll leave the Grafana annotation plug-in enabled so we can correlate the ramp events.

sam: One more: leave the fast-rollback command in your terminal history - it's saved to the team ops vault as well.

marie: Merging release notes now and tagging release channel. If anything changes, update this thread.

emma: Thanks all - rolling plan ready.
